subject.title: [Feature]: bearer token authentication for proxy servers

question: Should this issue continue to require QR/bootstrap and Android user-facing completion for static proxy headers, and should OIDC remain out of scope for a separate design?
rationale: The code now has partial static-header plumbing, but the remaining choices control pre-Gateway credentials, native secure storage, QR metadata, Android exposure, and OIDC redirect/token handling.

options.title: Stage static header completion
options.body: Keep the per-gateway custom-header direction, finish the missing Android user-entry and approved bootstrap/manual scope, and defer OIDC to a separate security design.

options.title: Close static mobile scope
options.body: Treat the merged iOS and Android runtime/storage slices as enough for this broad issue and require new narrowly scoped reports for QR, Android UI, OIDC, CLI, macOS, or share-extension gaps.

options.title: Design full proxy-auth suite
options.body: Hold the issue open for a broader cross-platform contract covering static headers, cookies, QR bootstrap metadata, and OIDC browser handoff together.

recommendation.title: Stage static header completion
recommendation.body: Keep the per-gateway custom-header direction, finish the missing Android user-entry and approved bootstrap/manual scope, and defer OIDC to a separate security design.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the landed static-header slices and the closed mobile tracker, so he has the clearest recent product/security context for the remaining scope decision.
